policies.name: kb-documents-are-retrievable-with-personal-data-redacted
policies.code:
@obligate_redact("email, name, ssn")
permit(principal, action == Action::"retrieve", resource) when { context.collection == "kb" };

tests.name: a knowledge-base document may be retrieved - email, name and ssn redacted first
the poisoned document is retrievable under the same obligation - screening, not policy, catches the payload
a document outside the knowledge base is denied
a retrieval that names no collection is denied (fail-closed)
no policy permits exporting the corpus
